newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - April 10.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
* The Central Intelligence Agency issued a report indicating intelligence errors may have led to the destruction of an Iraqi ammunition bunker after the 1991 Persian Gulf war.
* Tung Chee-Hwa, designated Hong Kong's first chief executive, announced plans to impose stricter controls on the rights of public protest and free association.
* House Speaker Newt Gingrich suggested all capital gains and estate taxes should be eliminated, and said he would put a tax cut to a vote this year.
* Republicans on the House committee investigating questionable campaign fund-raising practices said they would expand the investigation to include Republican campaigns.
* Los Angeles Mayor Richard Riordan was overwhelmingly re-elected to a second term.
* Scientists studying Europa, one of Jupiter's moons, said they were increasingly confident an ocean of liquid water or slush lay beneath that moon's surface of cracked ice.
* New interviews show a wider circle of White House officials knew of attempts to help former associate Attorney General Webster Hubbell.
